title: Splay vs MTTKRP
tagline: Compare data-structure access costs against tensor factorization workloads using asymptotic growth curves.

curves.label: Splay Tree Amortized
curves.code: function splayAccess(n){let x=0; for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){x += Math.log2(i+1);} return x;}
curves.name: Splay Tree Amortized

curves.label: MTTKRP Dense (Naive)
curves.code: function mttkrpDense(n){let ops=0; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){for(let j=0;j<n;j++){ops += 1;}} return ops;}
curves.name: MTTKRP Dense (Naive)

curves.label: MTTKRP Blocked (Cache-tiling)
curves.code: function mttkrpBlocked(n,B=64){let ops=0; for(let i=0;i<n;i+=B){for(let j=0;j<n;j+=B){for(let ii=i;ii<Math.min(i+B,n);ii++){for(let jj=j;jj<Math.min(j+B,n);jj++){ops+=1;}} ops += Math.log2(1+B);}} return ops;}
curves.name: MTTKRP Blocked (Cache-tiling)

curves.label: Compressed Tensor (Sparse Indexing)
curves.code: function sparseTensor(n){let nnz = Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n)*Math.log2(n+2)); let ops=0; for(let k=0;k<nnz;k++){ops += 1;} return ops;}
curves.name: Compressed Tensor (Sparse Indexing)

curves.label: AVL Tree Worst-Case
curves.code: function avlLookup(n){let ops=0; for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){ops += Math.log2(i+1);} return ops;}
curves.name: AVL Tree Worst-Case
